notes.title: Update 2.31
notes.notes:
Hey Horrorfans!

Today, we got another Quality of Life update.
We have removed some physics puzzles, as we recognized that they were more an annoyance than a fun quirk. We have Added a few quality updates that will make the game more playable.

[b]Fixes:[/b]

- Eye Spider monster attacks now triggers a very specific sound, which makes it clear when you are beeing attacked.
- Removed Big plank physics puzzles (Placing them to make a bridge)
- Added more save points.
- Fixed the Softlock in the end of the game. (You could lock yourself if you died after opening the door, as you'd spawn after the door but the door would be locked, now, the door has just been removed.)
- Reworked settings menu to look better
- Made the shooting enemy soldiers shoot 50% less fast to enable easier peaking behind cover for the player.
- Fixed some spelling errors.
- Placed the ''Ammo picked up'' and ''Door is locked'' texts somewhere else, so they dont overlap eachother and other texts.


[b]Added:[/b]

- Added Brightness option to settings menu


Hope you guys will enjoy the game! Be ready for "2.4 Halloween Update" coming this halloween!

notes.title: Claustrophobia: Update 2.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41342158/975b74f221f1bbbdbbb7d5202e44e6e365da8984.gif[/img]

Claustrophobia is back with a new ending, more content, new enemies and reloading mechanic for the PDW-K. Try this free update out now, And Escape the facility!

We have added many new things to claustrophobia as listed here below, now with a better and clearer ending, and more lore added in between the game. Also a new character has been added, a General, that wants to see you dead more than any thing else.

Added:

- Reload mechanic for PDW-K. (Submachine gun)
- Ammo to be found for PDW-K.
- New enemy; Hasmat Soldier
- New area; Habitat
- Extended story, about 30 minutes of extra gameplay.
- 2 more lore pages.
- New & Changed ending. (No spoilers here...)
- New combat OST for firefight.

Fixed:

- Visual bugs fixed.
- PDW-K sound change.
- PDW-K Fire rate increased.
- PDW-K max ammo changed to 33.
- PDW-K location in hand changed, now looks more realistic.

Thanks again everyone, and do try it out and let me know what you think!

darryl

sentinel studios

notes.title: Update 2.0, Coming soon.
notes.notes:
New Update Claustrophobia coming! 
[i][b]- This is a bit spoiler heavy! so if you want to play the game for the first time, dont read. -[/b][/i]

I launched a poll a few days ago on instagram where most people opted for a new update on claustrophobia instead of nothing or a sequal. With this in mind, I thought about what to add more. And I figured out that the ending of claustrophobia is pretty lack luster, and doesnt have enough depth.

Hence, I want to add a few more changed that will basically overhaul the whole ending and make it pretty large, This will add a LOT of content and it will definitely be worth replaying the game for.

I'm basically overhauling the story a bit, in the past, (SPOILERS!!) you would be taken and used for the Antidote of Anguss C2. But now I wanted to offer an alternative ending, you can pick up arms and fight the military shooter style, take them down and escape with a vehicle so that you won't be forced to die for the cause. 

[b]I will add a reload mechanic to the PDW-K (Submachinegun).

I will add enemy AI that will shoot and talk, which will add a whole new depth of combat.

I will add a extended story, where you evade the military and escape.

I will add more explaination for the story as a whole.

I will add about 1 hour to the core game. making this game approx. 5 hours long![/b]

Hope you guys will enjoy this Free DLC. I'm not planning on making making it a payed DLC because I just really want this game to shine, eventhough it's been released in 2021. (It should have been early access) But with over 300 sales, I really want it to get even higher!

Thanks for reading thus far, and I hope you guys have a great 1st month of 2024!

This update will come somewhere in the next week.

Cheers!

Sentinel Studios Team,

Darryl

notes.title: Update 1.8 RE-Release
notes.notes:
[b]Dear horror fans,[/b]

We've taken some steps to Re release claustrophobia, we've fixed all bugs that were found in the last year, and we have removed the Survival gameplay because of lack of intrest and to many bugs. It was a fun idea, but It did not really go as we had hoped so we decided to lay the priority more on the main game.

We have added some new areas, a new lab area that expands the core game by a bit, with a new enemy that we have taken from the survival gamemode. We have also re-wrote a few notes and expanded upon the story of Claustrophobia. With this Re-release, we really hope to revive the Claustrophobia game and hopefully you guys will like it more.

We also have made the game a bit smaller in size by removing some unnessesary files. It's not 18 gigabyte instead of 20 gigabyte.

Thanks so much for everyone who has played claustrophobia and who has let us know the issues with the game, we hope that this will solve all the problems and will keep the game alive!

Thanks again! And have fun!

The sentinelStudios Team

notes.title: UPDATE 1.70 SURVIVAL BETA
notes.notes:
[b]new update for #claustrophobia ![/b]

I am super excited to release a new update; [b]1.7 - The Survival Update BETA![/b]

I'm are releasing a survival game mode with 1 map currently. Survive 5 waves of enemies with a new weapon, and new enemies.
The survival game mode is in beta, I am are super excited for you guys to try it out and let me know what you guys think!
The reason for this update is to boost claustrophobia and give it more content. The game should've been released as ''early access'' but it's too late to change that now. I do want to make this game as fun and engaging as it can be, hence the updates.

What holds for the future? More updates, more maps, maybe even more weapons and enemies. It does depend on what people think about the new update, so it's highly appreciated if you can leave your comments in the discord or on steam so that I can see if it's positive or negative. And we can work from there.

I have plans of adding a small progression system, more weapons to unlock and more fun maps to play it with. Maybe even local multiplayer. What holds it back is the reception it will get! :)

Thanks for reading and hopefully you guys like it. It's live right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1667170/Claustrophobia/#app_reviews_hash

The update also has a bunch of fixes. See changelog below.

Fixes:

- Removed the spider's sighting sound after death
- Fixed some locations where you could get stuck

Content:

- NEW GAME MODE; SURVIVAL
- New enemy: Gore Mutant
- New Weapon: KA-91 (Ak-47 type assault rifle) With reload system, only available in survival
- Reload system for KA-91
- New soundscape in menu for survival
- New Survival menu
- Added more jump scares in campaign
- Added new map; Catacombs for survival


Also another request. If anyone here who has the game and hasnt reviewed it yet, perhaps you can leave a review? It will boost the game's discovery by a lot! :)
thanks!

[i]Sentinel Studios[/i]

notes.title: PATCH UPDATE 1.6
notes.notes:
Dear AMAZING FOLLOWERS!

Today we have released update 1.6, which features more things to do, a lot of fixes, gameplay overhauls and lower game size. We have a lot of fun ideas for the upcoming year with claustrophobia, we feel that it was not released in a good state and we should not have done so. However, the game is now in a great state. Hope you all like the update and thanks for the support thus far!


FIXES:

- Removed ''E'' bug that would appear out of no where but did not do anything
- Fixed Elevators at start
- Added a clear indication of where to go in the start
- Fixed tutorial pop-ups.
- Fixed sound issues of monsters even though there are no monsters nearby.
- Raised ammo for nailgun from 8 -> 12
- Changed AI-Mutant speed from 450 -> 350, 300 when end of chase. (This will make it much more easier to escape and hide)

CONTENT:

- Added a much more ''Claustrophobic feel'' This includes overhauled catabombs area, tutorial area for crouching at the start.
- Added new scares & sound effects.
- Overhauled PDW-K Machinegun sound effect, graphics and recoil for more realistic gun play.
- Extended the game a bit more, with new cave area and a few more rooms.
- Added more save points.
- Added a clear note that you CANNOT deal damage to mutants with the nailgun.

Hope you guys will enjoy this update!

Cheers.

Sentinel Studios

notes.title: PATCH UPDATE 1.41
notes.notes:
[b]Dear AMAZING FOLLOWERS![/b]

Hey everyone,

first of all i want to thank everyone for buying, making content and participating in our first horror title. I also want to let you guys know that all of the constructive remarks have been seen and noted. We are working really hard on making this game better and we are well aware of the state its currently in. Therefore we want to work hard on fixing the game as fast as we can.

Sentinel Studios is of origin a one man company but with help for other programmers and smaller companies we deliver our games what start as pet projects and hobbies. We are aware that the state of the game upon release isn't optimal and we should've waited longer. I do want to encourage you to come back on a later date to try it again after we have fixed all the current issues.

However, we want to still thank you for everything and we are working around the clock to fix bugs and make the player experience better. Thank you for supporting a small indie team and achieving my/our dream to once do this full time.

In this update we have fixed the following;

FIXES:

- Removed a few unpressable buttons and switches.
- Made the enemy run slower and deal less damage.
- Fixed save points, more save points and them working correctly.
- More fixes in the future!

CONTENT:

- Added 2 more ''lore pages'' hidden in the facilities.
- Added more objects in ''the tunnel'' for a easier passing of it. (this was considered to be too hard)






Cheers,

Sentinel Studios.
